Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh were brilliant with the new ball! They got three in no time but after that, they had to toil hard, the wicket was offering nothing and it was hard work for their bowlers. They though needed to be a lot more discipline but lack of wickets made them try things which saw them leak runs. The conditions are wonderful for batting though and their batters would want to make use of it. Pakistan on the other hand, would love to get a couple before Stumps.

Pakistan have declared then! End of a long batting effort from them and they have a big score on the board. At one stage, they were three down for not a lot and were in big trouble. However, the middle order stepped up. First Ayub and Shakeel steadied the ship. Ayub fell short after getting to a half ton but Shakeel continued. Rizwan was also at his best and both scored tons and put up a massive stand. They have taken their side into a position from where losing the game is quite difficult.

Another session dominated by Pakistan! They have managed to score over 100 runs and just lost the one wicket. It was the Rizwan and Shakeel show. They both got up their tons and continued to pile the misery on Bangladesh. Pakistan looked all set for a wicketless session but Hasan struck just before the break. Pakistan though will hope these two can continue the good work and they'll be hoping to put up a massive first innings score. Bangladesh need to continue to be patient, there's not a lot of help from the surface and all they can do for now is hit the right lines and lengths. Will we see someone bowl an inspiring spell for them and get them back into the game? We will find out.

Najmul Hossain Shanto turned to Shakib Al Hasan and Mehidy Hasan in the last phase of the session but even they didn't get much turn out of the deck. It feels like Bangladesh have to ground really hard to find a breakthrough. They needed this break to re-energise themselves. Stay tuned for the second session.

Hello and welcome to the action of Day 2 between Pakistan and Bangladesh. An intriguing Day 1 saw the first session blow out due to wet outfield but Bangladesh pacers cash in to a vibrant pitch which supported them really well in the second session however Pakistan came back strongly from a precarious  position of 16/3 to building a 98 run stand between Ayub and Shakeel. Both scored a fine fifty with Shakeel still out there unbeaten on 57 along with Rizwan. Bangladesh will be gutted as they allowed such a stand to build but will hope to start Day 2 with a couple of quick wickets in first session. Stay tuned for more updates.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1...

STUMPS! The light has begun to fade away and the umpires call it stumps. An excellent couple of sessions for Pakistan. From 16/3, they have bailed themselves out massively and all thanks to Shakeel and Ayub they end Day 1 on a high. Earlier, we lost a full session due to a wet outfield. The ground staff worked tremendously to get the ground ready and despite losing a session, we got a lot of good stuff to watch. Bangladesh used the new ball brilliantly as they got three wickets inside the first 10 overs. Shakeel and Ayub then negotiated the swing and just hung around as long as possible. Once the ball got old they scored runs briskly. Ayub scored a fine fifty before he fell. Shakeel too edged the ball a couple of times but got lucky. Rizwan and Shakeel are now batting for Pakistan and with their long tail, we feel they can build on Day 1. Join us for action on Day 2  Till then, cheers!

End of a very exciting session! It was Bangladesh who began brilliantly as they got three in no time after electing to bowl. However, Saud Shakeel and Ayub have fought back very well. They counter attacked and have put up a 65-run stand in no time. The wicket seems to have eased out quite a lot and Pakistan will hope the two set batters can make full use of it and keep batting. Bangladesh need to be a lot more consistent with their lines and lengths and be a lot more patient. An important session coming up. Stay tuned.

Bangladesh are coming here as the underdogs and with so much political unrest back home, the Bangladeshi fans will look forward to their star players for some entertainment. Not just entertainment, Bangladesh have a point to prove against Pakistan who are yet to win single match against them. A head-to-head record of 12-0 and Bangladesh will hope to break the unwanted record. Pakistan haven’t played Test match for quite a while, they too will hope for a dominating start to this Test match. Who do you think will win? Toss and team news in a bit.
